Canonical spelling decision (locked):
Nephoretti is the canonical form (and we treat the other spellings as aliases).
Alias map (safe to normalize as you edit):
Nephoretti: aliases = Neforetti, Nefforeti, Neforreti, Nephorete, and also Neferati (appears in earlier text as the same faction label).
05_the_garden_blooms
Nibiru: I’ve seen “Niburu” appear in filenames; unless you explicitly want two different things, normalize to Nibiru.

Torrhen: in these chapters it’s a title-name carried by at least two distinct beings across time (Zephyr’s original partner vs the Tidecaller-line Torrhen), so keep spelling consistent but don’t assume “same individual.”
